Made my own brake fluid extractor by combining this kit with HB or Amzn basic kits.

I’d been looking for something like this for a while since I purchased the hand operated VEVOR pressure bleeder for brake and clutch fluid. I just used the Subaru adapter this evening and it works seamlessly with the pressure pump. No leaks and very easy to use! Make sure you remove the small filter net from the brake reservoir before you use the adapter, as it will interfere with it! Only issue I had was during removal. After loosening the rubber seal, it took a bit of wriggling and force to remove the adapter from the reservoir. At least I know it’s formed a great seal!
